title: Outbox event identity survives repeated delivery attempts
method: Synthetic batch: 100 committed transactions each create one outbox event. Ten broker-accepted events are republished after a relay crash, so attempts = 100 + 10 = 110. Atomic consumer deduplication yields 100 unique local effects. External side effects and expired deduplication records are excluded.
alt: Outbox event identity survives repeated delivery attempts. Committed outbox events: 100 count; Delivery attempts: 110 count; Unique applied effects: 100 count. Illustrative values.
